headline: 4 killed as truck and pickup collide head-on in Bogura
summary: The victims, including the driver, were traveling in the pickup van and are believed to be residents of Mymensingh district.
details: Four people were killed on the spot after a truck and a pickup van collided head-on in Bogura's Kahaloo upazila today.
The accident occurred around 10:00 am in the Bou-Bazar area on the Bogura-Naogaon regional highway, according to police and locals.
Kahaloo Police Station Officer-in-Charge Shafiqul Islam confirmed that all four deceased, including the driver, were traveling in the pickup van.
Preliminary information suggests the victims were residents of Mymensingh district. One of them has been identified as Lutfor Rahman.
Kahaloo Fire Service and Civil Defence Team Leader Arju Ahmed stated that personnel were working at the scene to recover the bodies.

Kahaloo Police Station Officer-in-Charge Shafiqul Islam confirmed that all four deceased, including the driver, were traveling in the pickup van.

headline_marked: Costly stealth jet: [[US F-35 fighter jet crashes]] near California base
headline: Costly stealth jet: US F-35 fighter jet crashes near California base
summary: The pilot safely ejected before the $109 million aircraft went down near Marine Corps Air Station Miramar in San Diego.
details: A US Marine Corps F-35B stealth fighter jet crashed on Friday near Marine Corps Air Station Miramar in San Diego, California.
The pilot was able to eject from the aircraft before impact and was transported to a medical facility in stable condition.
Military officials stated the pilot is being treated for non-life-threatening injuries following the aviation mishap.
Footage from the scene showed a plume of smoke rising from the wreckage as firefighters worked to extinguish the flames.
The crash occurred near MCAS Miramar, a base famous for being the former home of the US Navy's 'Top Gun' school for elite pilots.
Each F-35B variant, which features vertical takeoff and landing capabilities, costs approximately $109 million according to Lockheed Martin.
caption:
A $109 million US stealth fighter jet has crashed in California. The pilot survived after ejecting just in time.

A US Marine Corps F-35B stealth fighter jet crashed on Friday near Marine Corps Air Station Miramar in San Diego, California.

The pilot was able to eject from the aircraft before impact and was transported to a medical facility in stable condition.

Military officials stated the pilot is being treated for non-life-threatening injuries following the aviation mishap.

Footage from the scene showed a plume of smoke rising from the wreckage as firefighters worked to extinguish the flames.

The crash occurred near MCAS Miramar, a base famous for being the former home of the US Navy's 'Top Gun' school for elite pilots.

Each F-35B variant, which features vertical takeoff and landing capabilities, costs approximately $109 million according to Lockheed Martin.
